welcome.step1Body: You're in! This is where local car enthusiasts meet, drive and share the passion. Here's a quick tour before you get started.
welcome.step2Title: The map is your home base
welcome.step2Body: Start from the map to see what's happening around you, share your live location with friends, and roll out together in convoys.

welcome.step4Body: Finish setting up your profile so others recognise you, and add your first car to your garage.

auth.carQuote01: "Any customer can have a car painted any color that he wants so long as it is black." –Henry Ford
auth.carQuote02: "Aerodynamics are for people who can't build engines." –Enzo Ferrari
auth.carQuote03: "I couldn't find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself." –Ferdinand Porsche
auth.carQuote05: "If everything seems under control, you're just not going fast enough." –Mario Andretti
auth.carQuote06: "Horsepower sells cars, torque wins races." –Carroll Shelby
auth.carQuote07: "Racing is life. Anything before or after is just waiting." –Steve McQueen
auth.carQuote08: "Second place is just the first place loser." –Dale Earnhardt
auth.carQuote09: "Straight roads are for fast cars, turns are for fast drivers." –Colin McRae
